preconditions.description: The value of n must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The value of m must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output must contain the size k of the beautiful set.
The number of points output must match the size k of the beautiful set.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= n and 0 <= y <= m for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All points must have coordinates within the specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: all(x + y > 0 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All points must satisfy the condition x + y > 0.

postconditions.expression: all((x1 - x2) ** 2 + (y1 - y2) ** 2 != (x1 - x2) ** 2 + (y1 - y2) ** 2 for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in combinations(points, 2))
postconditions.description: The distance between any two points must be a non-integer.
